引言：家族性高胆固醇血症（FH）是一种常染色体显性遗传病，以低密度脂蛋白胆固醇（LDL-C）水平升高和早发心血管疾病（CVD）为特征，患病率为1/300，且可被成功治疗。这些特征使其适合进行大规模筛查。

涵盖领域：本文回顾了通过使用“筛查”和“家族性高胆固醇血症”等术语所检索到的研究。重点介绍了临床标准（LDL-C；Simon Broome和荷兰脂质诊所网络评分）以及已应用于成人和儿童人群的机器学习和基因检测方法。

专家意见：尽管已有大量试点研究，但由于基因检测并非总是进行，数据仍然有限。根据医疗和教育系统模式的不同，似乎有两种方法最佳。在成人中，分层多标准筛查（可能结合人工智能方法）在临床上是具有成本效益的。儿童筛查，无论是使用新生儿干血斑还是在学校医学评估中进行分层筛查，都是可行的，且可能更具成本效益。遗传性多疾病基因检测在儿童或成人中也是可行的。任何国家筛查模式的选择将取决于国家照护模式、当地成本效益以及可用的实施资源。

title: Atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming in atrial fibrillation: a candidate mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy
summary: Atrial fibrillation (AF) commonly coexists with obesity, diabetes, and other cardiometabolic disorders. However, how systemic metabolic stress creates an arrhythmogenic atrial substrate remains unclear. This narrative review evaluates atrial fibroblast metabolic reprogramming as a testable mechanism within multicellular atrial cardiomyopathy, not as an established causal pathway. We organize the evidence by source: human atrial fibroblasts, human atrial tissue, atrial animal models, non-atrial cardiac fibroblasts, extracardiac fibroblasts, and reduced experimental systems. Studies of non-atrial cardiac and extracardiac fibroblasts independently implicate enhanced glycolysis, glutaminolysis, altered fatty acid metabolism, and redox or mechanosensitive signaling in myofibroblast activation. However, these processes were examined across different tissues and models and have not been shown to form a unified program in human atrial fibroblasts. Human atrial tissue and animal studies link metabolic stress, fibroblast activation, fibrosis, and AF but rarely establish fibroblast-specific metabolic causality. No study in the cited evidence set directly measured metabolism in human atrial fibroblasts; direct reports instead assessed activation, contraction, migration, and matrix output. We therefore position fibroblasts within a broader network of cardiomyocytes, endothelial cells, immune cells, adipocytes, smooth muscle cells, autonomic signaling, and thrombotic pathways. Therapeutic studies may support prevention or reverse atrial remodeling, but they do not show correction of human atrial fibroblast metabolism or regression of established atrial fibrosis. Direct cell-resolved profiling and atrium-specific, fibroblast-restricted perturbation are required to determine whether this mechanism is causal, reversible, and therapeutically actionable.

AI.tldr: 本文综述提出心房成纤维细胞代谢重编程可能是多细胞心房心肌病中连接代谢应激与AF的候选机制，但尚无研究直接测量人房成纤维细胞代谢，因果关系未确立。
AI.motivation: AF常与肥胖、糖尿病等代谢紊乱共存，但系统代谢应激如何形成致心律失常心房基质尚不清楚；既往证据多来自非心房或非人类模型，缺乏心房成纤维细胞特异性代谢因果证据。
AI.method: 叙述性综述，按证据来源组织：人房成纤维细胞、人心房组织、心房动物模型、非心房心脏成纤维细胞、心外成纤维细胞及简化实验系统；未进行系统检索或定量合并，重点评估代谢重编程作为可检验机制而非既定因果通路。
AI.result: 非心房心脏及心外成纤维细胞研究独立提示糖酵解增强、谷氨酰胺分解、脂肪酸代谢改变及氧化还原或机械敏感信号参与肌成纤维细胞活化；但上述过程跨不同组织与模型，未在人房成纤维细胞中证实形成统一程序。人心房组织与动物研究将代谢应激、成纤维细胞活化、纤维化与AF相关联，但很少建立成纤维细胞特异性代谢因果；所引证据集中无研究直接测量人房成纤维细胞代谢，直接报道评估的是活化、收缩、迁移和基质输出。治疗研究可能支持预防或逆转心房重构，但未显示纠正人房成纤维细胞代谢或逆转已建立的心房纤维化。
AI.conclusion: 心房成纤维细胞代谢重编程是连接代谢应激与AF的合理候选机制，但当前证据不足以确立因果性、可逆性或治疗可操作性；需直接细胞分辨 profiling 及心房特异性、成纤维细胞限制性扰动研究来验证。

summary_zh: 心房颤动（AF）常与肥胖、糖尿病及其他心脏代谢紊乱共存。然而，系统性代谢应激如何形成致心律失常的心房基质仍不清楚。本叙述性综述评估心房成纤维细胞代谢重编程作为多细胞心房心肌病中一种可检验的机制，而非已确立的因果通路。我们按证据来源进行组织：人心房成纤维细胞、人心房组织、心房动物模型、非心房心脏成纤维细胞、心外成纤维细胞以及简化实验系统。对非心房心脏和心外成纤维细胞的研究独立提示糖酵解增强、谷氨酰胺分解、脂肪酸代谢改变以及氧化还原或机械敏感信号传导参与肌成纤维细胞活化。然而，这些过程是在不同组织和模型中 examined，尚未被证明在人心房成纤维细胞中形成统一程序。人心房组织和动物研究将代谢应激、成纤维细胞活化、纤维化和AF联系起来，但很少确立成纤维细胞特异性代谢因果关系。在引用的证据集中，没有研究直接测量人心房成纤维细胞的代谢；直接报告反而评估了活化、收缩、迁移和基质输出。因此，我们将成纤维细胞置于心肌细胞、内皮细胞、免疫细胞、脂肪细胞、平滑肌细胞、自主神经信号传导和血栓通路的更广泛网络中。治疗性研究可能支持预防或逆转心房重构，但并未显示纠正人心房成纤维细胞代谢或已确立心房纤维化的消退。需要直接细胞分辨谱分析和心房特异性、成纤维细胞限制性扰动来确定该机制是否具有因果性、可逆性和治疗可操作性。

title: Case Report: Fabry cardiomyopathy associated with a novel truncating <i>GLA</i> variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter)
summary: We report the comprehensive clinical characterization of a woman with Fabry disease (FD) carrying a previously unreported truncating GLA variant, c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter). The patient, a 52-year-old woman with longstanding hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, was referred to a specialized Fabry Disease Program to investigate FD as the underlying etiology of her cardiomyopathy. Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated diffuse left ventricular hypertrophy with extensive late gadolinium enhancement, indicating advanced replacement fibrosis and an increased arrhythmic risk. Biochemical evaluation revealed reduced α-galactosidase A activity and markedly elevated Lyso-Gb3 levels. Comprehensive systemic assessment identified bilateral cornea verticillata and nonspecific periventricular white matter hyperintensities on brain magnetic resonance imaging, while renal function remained preserved without clinically significant renal involvement. Molecular analysis identified the heterozygous truncating GLA variant c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter), which had not previously been reported. The patient received an implantable cardioverter-defibrillator following cardiovascular risk assessment and subsequently initiated enzyme replacement therapy with agalsidase beta. This case expands the known mutational spectrum of the GLA gene and illustrates the value of integrating molecular genetic analysis with multimodality cardiac imaging and comprehensive phenotyping in patients with unexplained hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. This integrated approach not only supports the interpretation of previously unreported GLA variants but may also refine etiologic diagnosis, cardiovascular risk assessment, and individualized clinical management in FD.

AI.tldr: 一例52岁女性肥厚型心肌病患者检出新型GLA截短变异c.837_838delinsAT，确诊Fabry病心肌病，经ICD和酶替代治疗管理。
AI.motivation: Fabry病是肥厚型心肌病的重要可治病因，但既往报道的GLA变异有限，新变异的致病性解读和临床表型认识不足，需通过多模态评估整合分子遗传与影像学以明确诊断和风险分层。
AI.method: 病例报告。对象为52岁女性，长期肥厚型心肌病，转诊至Fabry病专科项目。进行心脏磁共振、酶活性与Lyso-Gb3检测、系统评估（眼科、脑MRI、肾功能）及GLA基因测序。主要观察临床表型、变异鉴定及管理决策。
AI.result: 心脏MRI示弥漫性左室肥厚伴广泛晚期钆增强，提示晚期替代性纤维化和心律失常风险增高；α-半乳糖苷酶A活性降低、Lyso-Gb3显著升高；双眼角膜涡状混浊，脑MRI示非特异性脑室旁白质高信号，肾功能保留；基因检测发现杂合截短变异c.837_838delinsAT, p.(Gln280Ter)，既往未报道。患者经心血管风险评估后植入ICD，并启动阿加糖酶β酶替代治疗。
AI.conclusion: 该病例扩展了GLA基因突变谱，提示对不明原因肥厚型心肌病应整合分子遗传、多模态心脏影像和系统表型评估，以支持新变异解读、病因诊断、心血管风险分层和个体化管理。局限性为单例报告，变异致病性需功能验证。

summary_zh: 我们报告了一位携带既往未报道的截短型GLA变异c.837_838delinsAT，p.(Gln280Ter)的法布里病（FD）女性的全面临床特征。该患者为52岁女性，患有长期肥厚型心肌病，被转诊至专门的法布里病项目，以探究FD作为其心肌病潜在病因的可能性。心脏磁共振成像显示弥漫性左心室肥厚伴广泛晚期钆增强，提示晚期替代性纤维化和心律失常风险增加。生化评估显示α-半乳糖苷酶A活性降低，Lyso-Gb3水平显著升高。全面的系统性评估发现双侧角膜涡状混浊和脑磁共振成像上非特异性脑室周围白质高信号，而肾功能保持正常，无临床显著的肾脏受累。分子分析鉴定出杂合截短型GLA变异c.837_838delinsAT，p.(Gln280Ter)，该变异既往未见报道。患者在接受心血管风险评估后植入了植入式心律转复除颤器，随后开始使用阿加糖酶β进行酶替代治疗。本病例扩展了GLA基因已知的突变谱，并说明了将分子遗传学分析与多模态心脏成像及全面表型分析相结合在不明原因肥厚型心肌病患者中的价值。这种整合方法不仅有助于解读既往未报道的GLA变异，还可能改善FD的病因诊断、心血管风险评估和个体化临床管理。

title: Neurocardiac crosstalk in inherited cardiac arrhythmias and cardiomyopathy
summary: Inherited cardiac conditions are a leading cause of sudden cardiac death in young and otherwise healthy patients. They result from mutations in genes that encode proteins with various physiological functions. Despite knowledge of the underlying genetic basis, the disorders remain incompletely understood. There is significant interindividual variability in disease expression amongst patients, and incomplete penetrance amongst mutation carriers, indicating a more complex basis to these disorders. This review first discusses the well-established role of the autonomic nervous system (ANS) in acquired cardiac conditions, and subsequently focuses on several classically considered 'cardiac' conditions in which the ANS is known to play an important role: the inherited channelopathies catecholaminergic polymorphic ventricular tachycardia (CPVT), Brugada syndrome (BrS) and long QT syndrome type 3 (LQT3), as well as an inherited arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy (ACM). Despite each condition being caused by different genetic mutations, they share a fundamental commonality in that cardiac-modulating neurons (e.g. those of the stellate and intracardiac ganglia) have recently been shown to be affected in addition to cardiomyocytes. Through closer examination of the pathophysiological contribution of a dysfunctional ANS to these conditions, novel avenues for both risk stratification and treatment design are likely to emerge.

AI.tldr: 综述指出遗传性心律失常和心肌病中自主神经系统功能障碍与心肌细胞病变共同参与，为风险分层和治疗提供新方向。
AI.motivation: 遗传性心脏疾病是年轻健康人群心源性猝死的主要原因，虽已知遗传基础，但疾病表达个体差异大、外显不全，机制未完全阐明，需探索心肌外因素如自主神经系统的作用。
AI.method: 本文为综述，先讨论自主神经系统在获得性心脏病中的作用，后聚焦遗传性离子通道病（CPVT、Brugada综合征、LQT3）和致心律失常性心肌病（ACM），总结心脏调节神经元（星状神经节和心内神经节）受累的证据。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体研究数据或统计结果，但指出这些不同基因突变所致的疾病中，心脏调节神经元与心肌细胞同样受累，自主神经系统功能障碍参与病理生理。
AI.conclusion: 自主神经系统功能障碍在遗传性心律失常和心肌病中起重要作用，针对该系统的干预可能为风险分层和治疗设计提供新途径，但需进一步研究验证。

summary_zh: 遗传性心脏病是年轻且其他方面健康的患者发生心脏性猝死的主要原因。它们由编码具有各种生理功能蛋白质的基因突变引起。尽管对潜在遗传基础有所了解，但这些疾病仍未被完全理解。患者之间的疾病表达存在显著的个体间变异性，突变携带者中存在不完全外显，表明这些疾病具有更复杂的基础。本综述首先讨论自主神经系统（ANS）在获得性心脏病中已确立的作用，随后重点讨论几种经典被认为的“心脏”疾病，已知ANS在其中发挥重要作用：遗传性通道病包括儿茶酚胺敏感性多形性室性心动过速（CPVT）、Brugada综合征（BrS）和长QT综合征3型（LQT3），以及一种遗传性致心律失常性心肌病（ACM）。尽管每种疾病由不同的基因突变引起，但它们有一个基本的共同点，即最近显示除了心肌细胞外，心脏调节神经元（例如星状神经节和心内神经节的神经元）也受到影响。通过更仔细地检查功能障碍的ANS对这些疾病的病理生理贡献，很可能出现用于风险分层和治疗设计的新途径。

title: Preimplantation genetic testing to determine polygenic disease risk: Will we know when to stop?
authors: Daniela Paes de Almeida Ferreira Braga
summary: Recent advances in genomics technologies have facilitated the introduction of new tools that broaden the scope of applications for genetic data. Preimplantation genetic testing using polygenic risk scores (PGT-P), a technique based on the fact that complex traits are influenced by multiple genes, is one such technology. Polygenic risk scoring involves the analysis of many genes in a single embryo to assess the odds of expressing diseaseand non-disease-related factors. This technique could alleviate subsequent burdens on healthcare systems, as it could lead to a population with reduced polygenic risk scores, potentially resulting in a lower incidence of genetic conditions, such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. However, following the introduction of PGT-P, numerous ethical concerns regarding its use have been raised. As such, it is crucial to gain a deeper understanding of stakeholder viewpoints regarding the technique. Worries include the validity and utility of PGT-P, limitations related to the number of embryos and available choices, and the challenges faced by prospective parents in terms of understanding and making informed decisions. Recently, published surveys have indicated that PGT-P is well accepted by both the general population and assisted reproduction patients; however, experts are concerned about the premature implementation of the technique. These findings raise the question of whether the general population is aware of the risks of technologies that could potentially manipulate the traits of future generations. To conclude, the value of PGT-P is indisputable if applied with caution, especially if relevant limits are not exceeded.

AI.tldr: PGT-P技术通过多基因风险评分筛选胚胎以降低多基因病风险，但专家担忧其过早应用，需谨慎并明确限制。
AI.motivation: 基因组学进展使多基因风险评分（PRS）可用于胚胎植入前遗传学检测（PGT-P），以评估复杂疾病风险。该技术有望降低人群多基因病负担，但引发伦理担忧，包括有效性、胚胎数量限制及知情决策挑战。需了解利益相关者观点以指导应用。
AI.method: 本文为综述，总结近期关于PGT-P的伦理讨论和调查结果。调查显示普通人群和辅助生殖患者接受度较高，但专家担忧过早实施。摘要未报告具体研究类型、样本量或统计方法。
AI.result: 近期调查表明PGT-P在普通人群和辅助生殖患者中接受度良好，但专家对过早实施表示担忧。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%置信区间或P值。
AI.conclusion: PGT-P在谨慎应用且不超越相关限制时具有明确价值，但需关注伦理问题并确保充分知情决策。临床实践中应平衡技术潜力与风险，避免过早推广。

summary_zh: 基因组学技术的最新进展促进了新工具的出现，这些工具拓宽了遗传数据的应用范围。基于多基因风险评分的植入前遗传学检测（PGT-P）就是这样一种技术，该技术基于复杂性状受多个基因影响这一事实。多基因风险评分涉及对单个胚胎中的许多基因进行分析，以评估表达疾病和非疾病相关因素的可能性。这项技术可以减轻医疗系统的后续负担，因为它可能产生多基因风险评分降低的人群，从而可能降低心血管疾病和癌症等遗传疾病的发生率。然而，在PGT-P引入后，人们对其使用提出了许多伦理方面的担忧。因此，深入了解利益相关者对该技术的看法至关重要。担忧包括PGT-P的有效性和实用性、与胚胎数量和可用选择相关的限制，以及准父母在理解和做出知情决策方面面临的挑战。最近发表的调查表明，PGT-P被普通人群和辅助生殖患者广泛接受；然而，专家们对该技术的过早实施表示担忧。这些发现提出了一个问题：普通人群是否意识到那些可能操纵后代特征的技术所伴随的风险。总之，如果谨慎应用，特别是如果没有超越相关限制，PGT-P的价值是无可争议的。

title: Electrophysiological Manifestations of Suspected Bachmann's Bundle Infarction Due to Occlusion of the Right Sinus Node Artery
Large language model versus dual human title/abstract screening in a live systematic review (CRD420261518811)
summary: This pre-registered study within a review will compare title/abstract screening by large language models (primary claude-opus-5-5, secondary claude-sonnet-5, each run through the official Claude Code client in fresh, isolated, single-turn sessions with frozen prompts) against dual independent human screening of the 5,629 records in Covidence title/abstract screening for a live systematic review of direct-current cardioversion for atrial arrhythmias in cardiac amyloidosis (PROSPERO CRD420261518811). The protocol, prompts, hash-locked input cohort and execution configuration are registered while human screening is under way, and model predictions are generated only after the human reference standard (dual title/abstract and full-text screening with adjudication) is locked and its snapshot hashed in an OSF registration update, so no prediction exists while humans screen. The primary, descriptive outcome is the number of included study families the model would have lost and study-level recall with an exact 95% CI; secondary outcomes include record-level agreement metrics, work saved, run-to-run agreement on a stability subsample, a human-plus-model simulation, reviewer mix, cost, tokens and time, and an impact analysis.

AI.tldr: 在心脏淀粉样变房性心律失常直流电复律的系统评价中，拟比较大型语言模型与双人独立标题/摘要筛选，但摘要未报告任何预测或比较结果。
AI.motivation: 系统评价的标题/摘要筛选耗时且依赖人工，大型语言模型能否替代或辅助双人独立筛选尚缺乏在真实系统评价流程中的验证证据。
AI.method: 预注册的嵌套方法学研究（PROSPERO CRD420261518811），针对心脏淀粉样变房性心律失常直流电复律的实时系统评价，Covidence中5,629条记录。以双人独立标题/摘要筛选加全文筛选及仲裁为人类参考标准，在参考标准锁定并哈希快照后，由claude-opus-5-5（主）和claude-sonnet-5（次）在隔离单轮会话中生成预测。主要终点为模型会漏掉的纳入研究家族数及研究水平召回率（精确95%CI）；次要终点包括记录水平一致性、节省工作量、稳定性子样本的重复运行一致性、人机联合模拟、审稿人构成、成本、token与时间及影响分析。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何结果数据；模型预测仅在人类参考标准锁定后生成，故本文摘要中无召回率、一致性、成本等数值。
AI.conclusion: 该研究设计可在不污染人类筛选的前提下评估大型语言模型用于标题/摘要筛选的召回与效率，但当前摘要无结果，尚不能判断其能否替代或辅助双人独立筛选；需等待完整结果发表。

summary_zh: 这项在综述内开展的预注册研究将比较大型语言模型的标题/摘要筛选（主要模型为 claude-opus-5-5，次要模型为 claude-sonnet-5，二者均在全新、隔离、单轮会话中通过官方 Claude Code 客户端运行，并使用冻结的提示词）与双人独立人工筛选，后者在 Covidence 中对 5,629 条记录进行标题/摘要筛选，该综述是一项关于心脏淀粉样变性中心房心律失常直流电复律的实时系统综述（PROSPERO CRD420261518811）。研究方案、提示词、哈希锁定的输入队列和执行配置在人工筛选进行期间注册，而模型预测仅在人工参考标准（双人标题/摘要及全文筛选并裁决）锁定且其快照在 OSF 注册更新中完成哈希后生成，因此人工筛选期间不存在任何预测。主要描述性结局是模型将会遗漏的纳入研究家族数量以及研究层面的召回率（精确 95% CI）；次要结局包括记录层面的一致性指标、节省的工作量、稳定性子样本上的运行间一致性、人工加模型模拟、综述作者构成、成本、token 和时间，以及影响分析。

title: CLINICAL CHARACTERISTICS AND CLINICAL SIGNIFICANCE OF ARRHYTHMIAS IN WOMEN OF REPRODUCTIVE AGE WITH IRON DEFICIENCY ANEMIA
summary: Iron deficiency anemia is one of the most common hematological conditions among women of reproductive age and may be associated with various functional changes in the cardiovascular system, including palpitations, tachycardia, reduced exercise tolerance and cardiac rhythm disturbances. A decrease in hemoglobin levels reduces the oxygen-carrying capacity of the blood and may increase compensatory cardiovascular workload. The aim of this study was to assess the clinical characteristics and clinical significance of arrhythmias in women of reproductive age with iron deficiency anemia. Particular attention was given to the relationship between anemia severity, iron status and cardiovascular manifestations, as well as electrocardiographic changes and rhythm disturbances. The findings indicate that comprehensive assessment of hematological parameters together with cardiovascular evaluation may contribute to earlier detection of cardiac rhythm abnormalities. Electrocardiography and, when clinically indicated, Holter monitoring may provide additional diagnostic information in patients with recurrent palpitations and other cardiovascular symptoms. Early identification and correction of iron deficiency may help reduce cardiovascular manifestations and improve the functional status of affected women

AI.tldr: 育龄期缺铁性贫血女性常出现心悸、心动过速及心电图节律异常，贫血严重程度与铁状态同心血管表现相关，早期纠正缺铁可能减轻症状。
AI.motivation: 缺铁性贫血是育龄期女性最常见的血液学疾病之一，可导致心悸、心动过速、运动耐量下降和心律紊乱，但既往对其心律失常的临床特征及与贫血严重程度、铁状态的关系关注不足，缺乏系统的心血管评估证据。
AI.method: 研究为临床观察性评估，对象为育龄期缺铁性贫血女性；旨在评估心律失常的临床特征与临床意义，重点关注贫血严重程度、铁状态与心血管表现、心电图改变及节律紊乱之间的关系；具体样本量、分组方式、终点定义及统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体样本量、效应量、95%置信区间或P值；仅定性指出缺铁性贫血女性存在心悸、心动过速、运动耐量下降及心律紊乱，贫血严重程度和铁状态与心血管表现相关，心电图及必要时动态心电图监测可提供额外诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: 综合血液学与心血管评估有助于更早发现节律异常，对反复心悸等症状者应行心电图、必要时Holter监测；早期识别并纠正缺铁可能减少心血管表现、改善功能状态。但摘要缺乏定量数据，结论的循证强度有限，尚需大样本前瞻性研究验证。

summary_zh: 缺铁性贫血是育龄女性中最常见的血液学疾病之一，可能与心血管系统的多种功能性改变相关，包括心悸、心动过速、运动耐量下降和心律紊乱。血红蛋白水平下降会降低血液的携氧能力，并可能增加代偿性心血管负荷。本研究旨在评估育龄缺铁性贫血女性中心律失常的临床特征及临床意义。研究特别关注贫血严重程度、铁状态与心血管表现之间的关系，以及心电图改变和心律紊乱。研究结果表明，综合评估血液学参数并结合心血管评估可能有助于更早发现心律异常。对于反复心悸和其他心血管症状的患者，心电图检查以及在临床有指征时进行动态心电图监测可能提供额外的诊断信息。早期识别和纠正缺铁可能有助于减少心血管表现并改善受影响女性的功能状态。

title: Electrocardiogram Analysis from Beat-Level Arrhythmias to WPW Ventricular Pre-Excitation and Glycemic Disorders: A Scoping Review
summary: This scoping review analyzes 16 studies on computational methods for the analysis of cardiac arrhythmias, ventricular pre-excitation associated with Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome, and glycemic disorders. The corpus was compiled from records identified in the IEEE Xplore, PubMed, and Scopus databases, supplemented by searches using the Consensus tool. The studies were compared regarding datasets, input representations, computational methods, validation protocols, performance, explainability, and limitations. The results demonstrate high performance, particularly on controlled datasets, but also reveal recurring limitations, including beat-level data splitting without patient-level separation, limited external validation, small sample sizes, reliance on pre-trained models, predominantly qualitative explainability assessment, and insufficient control of confounding factors. Regarding ventricular pre-excitation, further research is needed to integrate segmentation, fiducial features, temporal signals, time-frequency representations, and explainability methods with more robust clinical validation. As for glycemic alterations, the findings support the use of the ECG as a complementary marker for hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia, although it does not replace reference glucose measurements. Overall, the review highlights the potential of ECG-derived physiological features for machine learning models aimed at detecting cardiac and metabolic anomalies, while emphasizing the need for more robust validation and clinically grounded assessment.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 本范围综述分析16项研究，发现心电图机器学习方法在受控数据集上性能高，但存在数据划分未按患者分离、外部验证不足等局限，且心电图可作为血糖异常的补充标志物。
AI.motivation: 心电图计算分析方法在心律失常、WPW综合征心室预激及血糖紊乱中的应用日益增多，但既往研究缺乏对方法学质量和临床验证的系统评估，需要明确现有证据的缺口。
AI.method: 范围综述，纳入16项研究，检索IEEE Xplore、PubMed和Scopus数据库并补充Consensus工具检索；比较数据集、输入表示、计算方法、验证方案、性能、可解释性和局限性。
AI.result: 方法在受控数据集上性能高，但常见局限包括：按心搏划分数据而未按患者分离、外部验证有限、样本量小、依赖预训练模型、可解释性评估以定性为主、混杂因素控制不足；摘要未报告具体效应量或P值。
AI.conclusion: 心电图衍生特征结合机器学习在检测心脏和代谢异常方面有潜力，但需更稳健的验证和临床评估；对心室预激需整合多模态特征与可解释性方法，心电图可作为高血糖和低血糖的补充标志物但不能替代参考血糖测量。

summary_zh: 本范围综述分析了16项关于心律失常分析计算方法、与Wolff-Parkinson-White综合征相关的室性预激以及血糖紊乱的研究。该语料库由IEEE Xplore、PubMed和Scopus数据库中识别的记录汇编而成，并辅以使用Consensus工具的检索。研究在数据集、输入表示、计算方法、验证方案、性能、可解释性和局限性方面进行了比较。结果表明性能较高，尤其是在受控数据集上，但也揭示了反复出现的局限性，包括未按患者水平分离的搏动级数据划分、有限的外部验证、小样本量、对预训练模型的依赖、以定性为主的可解释性评估以及对混杂因素控制不足。关于室性预激，需要进一步研究将分割、基准特征、时间信号、时频表示和可解释性方法与更稳健的临床验证相结合。至于血糖改变，研究结果支持使用ECG作为高血糖和低血糖的补充标志物，尽管它不能替代参考葡萄糖测量。总体而言，该综述强调了ECG衍生的生理特征在旨在检测心脏和代谢异常的机器学习模型中的潜力，同时强调需要更稳健的验证和基于临床的评估。

title: Automation of the experimental setup for functional studies in isolated perfused hearts
summary: Although the ex vivo cardiac perfusion system based on the Langendorff model is widely used in studies of cardiac arrhythmias using isolated hearts, it still relies, in many cases, on the manual control of critical parameters such as pressure, temperature, and flow, compromising the reproducibility and accuracy of experiments. This project aims to implement, at the HEartLab Cardiac Electrophysiology Laboratory of the Federal University of ABC, which operates a Langendorff setup, high-precision digital sensors, electronic actuators, servo motors, microcontrollers (Arduino Nano and ESP32), and wireless communication modules (nRF24L01) to enable the real-time monitoring and control of physiological variables (flow, pressure, and temperature), thereby promoting greater experimental stability and reducing the need for human intervention. The expected outcomes include the development of low-cost, configurable, and modular monitoring and control devices with potential applications in other areas of electrophysiology and biomedical engineering research.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 本项目在Langendorff离体心脏灌流平台上集成数字传感器、执行器与无线通信模块，实现流量、压力和温度的实时监测与自动控制，以减少人工干预、提高实验可重复性。
AI.motivation: 基于Langendorff模型的离体心脏灌流系统广泛用于心律失常研究，但压力、温度和流量等关键参数多依赖人工调控，影响实验的可重复性与准确性，因此需要低成本、可配置的自动化方案。
AI.method: 研究类型为设备与方法学开发项目，实施地点为巴西ABC联邦大学HEartLab心脏电生理实验室的Langendorff灌流平台；技术方案包括高精度数字传感器、电子执行器、伺服电机、Arduino Nano与ESP32微控制器及nRF24L01无线通信模块，目标是实现流量、压力、温度的实时监测与控制；样本量、终点定义与统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量结果；预期产出为低成本、可配置、模块化的监测与控制装置，并可能推广至电生理和生物医学工程的其他研究领域。
AI.conclusion: 该方案有望提升离体心脏电生理实验的稳定性与标准化程度，减少人工干预带来的变异；但目前仅为项目计划，尚缺乏实测性能数据与验证结果，其对实验可重复性的实际改善仍需后续研究证实。

summary_zh: 尽管基于Langendorff模型的离体心脏灌注系统广泛用于使用离体心脏的心律失常研究，但在许多情况下，它仍然依赖于对压力、温度和流量等关键参数的手动控制，从而影响了实验的可重复性和准确性。本项目旨在巴西ABC联邦大学心脏电生理实验室（HEartLab）——该实验室运行一套Langendorff装置——实施高精度数字传感器、电子执行器、伺服电机、微控制器（Arduino Nano和ESP32）以及无线通信模块（nRF24L01），以实现对生理变量（流量、压力和温度）的实时监测与控制，从而促进更高的实验稳定性并减少人工干预的需求。预期成果包括开发低成本、可配置且模块化的监测与控制设备，这些设备在电生理学和生物医学工程研究的其他领域具有潜在应用。

title: Architectural Rigidity versus Modern Scaling Laws in Asymmetric Medical Data for Cardiac Arrhythmia Classification
summary: remain paramount to safeguarding diagnostic sensitivity in real-world asymmetric medical data streams.Automated cardiac arrhythmia classification is vital for enhancing intensive care monitoring and reducing clinician alarm fatigue. However, extreme intrinsic class imbalance across standard pathological categories often leads to the complete suppression of minority class features during deep learning optimization. This study presents a rigorous architectural bench-mark evaluating five state-of-the-art convolutional neural net-works—ResNet50, ResNet50V2, EfficientNetV2B0, DenseNet121, and ConvNeXtTiny—under varying degrees of data scarcity. Moving away from static dataset splits, we implement an exhaustive 4-fold cross-rotation validation pipeline that operates on a cumulative pool of 109,381 2D ECG derivative images generated from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database and structured according to the AAMI/ANSI EC57 standard. The consolidated multi-round results reveal a critical engineering trade-off: next generation networks optimized under modern computational scaling laws (EfficientNetV2B0 and ConvNeXtTiny) suffer a catastrophic feature drain toward majoritarian normal profiles in hyper-sparse configurations, collapsing to 0.00% F1-scores when class support drops below a critical threshold. Conversely, the classical ResNet50 framework demonstrates superior topological preservation, anchoring minority gradient pathways through its unregularized identity shortcut connections. ResNet50 achieved the highest consolidated mean global accuracy (92.16% ± 7.15%) and a resilient classification standard for the rarest abnormal class (61.01% ± 39.81% F1-score), heavily outperforming its modernized counterparts. These findings introduce a pivotal paradigm shift for clinical software deployment, demonstrating that structural rigidity and unpruned architectural highways remain paramount to safeguarding diagnostic sensitivity in realworld asymmetric medical data streams.
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

AI.tldr: 在高度不平衡的心电数据中，经典ResNet50比现代缩放网络（EfficientNetV2B0、ConvNeXtTiny）更能保持少数类诊断敏感性，后者在类别支持极低时F1-score崩溃至0.00%。
AI.motivation: 自动心律失常分类对重症监护和减少警报疲劳至关重要，但标准病理类别间的极端内在类别不平衡常导致深度学习优化过程中少数类特征被完全抑制，既往证据缺乏对不同架构在数据稀缺下诊断敏感性的系统评估。
AI.method: 研究为架构基准评估，使用MIT-BIH心律失常数据库生成的109,381张2D心电导数图像，按AAMI/ANSI EC57标准结构化。采用4折交叉旋转验证流程，评估ResNet50、ResNet50V2、EfficientNetV2B0、DenseNet121和ConvNeXtTiny五种卷积神经网络在不同数据稀缺程度下的表现，主要终点为全局准确率和最稀有异常类的F1-score。
AI.result: ResNet50获得最高合并平均全局准确率92.16%±7.15%，最稀有异常类F1-score为61.01%±39.81%；而EfficientNetV2B0和ConvNeXtTiny在超稀疏配置下特征向多数类正常轮廓流失，当类别支持低于临界阈值时F1-score崩溃至0.00%。
AI.conclusion: 结构刚性和未剪枝的架构通路对保障真实世界不对称医疗数据流中的诊断敏感性至关重要，提示临床软件部署应优先考虑经典ResNet50类架构；但研究基于单中心数据库和图像化心电数据，结论外推需谨慎。

summary_zh: 自动化心脏心律失常分类对于增强重症监护监测和减少临床医生警报疲劳至关重要。然而，标准病理类别中极端的内在类别不平衡往往导致深度学习优化过程中少数类特征的完全抑制。本研究提出了一个严格的架构基准，评估了五种最先进的卷积神经网络——ResNet50、ResNet50V2、EfficientNetV2B0、DenseNet121和ConvNeXtTiny——在不同程度的数据稀缺条件下的表现。我们摒弃了静态数据集划分，实施了一个详尽的4折交叉轮换验证流程，该流程在累计池上运行，该池包含109,381张由MIT-BIH心律失常数据库生成并根据AAMI/ANSI EC57标准结构化的2D ECG衍生图像。合并的多轮结果揭示了一个关键的工程权衡：在现代计算缩放定律下优化的下一代网络（EfficientNetV2B0和ConvNeXtTiny）在超稀疏配置中遭受灾难性的特征流失，向多数类正常特征崩溃，当类别支持度降至临界阈值以下时，F1分数骤降至0.00%。相反，经典的ResNet50框架表现出卓越的拓扑保持能力，通过其未正则化的恒等捷径连接锚定少数类梯度路径。ResNet50实现了最高的合并平均全局准确率（92.16% ± 7.15%）和最稀有异常类的弹性分类标准（61.01% ± 39.81% F1分数），大幅优于其现代化 counterparts。这些发现为临床软件部署引入了关键的范式转变，表明结构刚性和未剪枝的架构高速公路对于保障现实世界非对称医疗数据流中的诊断敏感性仍然至关重要。

title: TRACE: Expert-Aligned ECG Representation Learning with Rigorous Benchmarking and Real-World Validation in Acute Cardiac Care
summary: TRACE (Text-Reinforced Analysis of Cardio ECGs) is a multimodal electrocardiogram (ECG) representation model that learns clinically grounded signal embeddings for downstream cardiac classification. It is designed to address the limitations of existing CLIP-style training, which often struggles with noisy clinical text and fails to leverage the complementary strengths of unimodal (from ECG) and cross-modal (between ECG and matched cardiologist reports) learning. To bridge this gap, we propose a hybrid architecture that jointly learns unimodal and cross-modal representations via uncertainty-weighted multi-task learning while utilizing an LLM-based pipeline to extract high-fidelity findings from cardiologist reports. We evaluate TRACE across a spectrum of clinical urgency, establishing robust performance on public benchmarks for arrhythmia classification and structural abnormalities relative to existing unimodal and multimodal ECG models. To demonstrate real-world utility, we further validate the model on acute coronary occlusion (ACO), where the prevailing ST-elevation criteria miss 25-34% of true occlusions. Utilizing a large private ACO dataset with expert-annotated ground truth, TRACE significantly outperforms real-world clinical practice, yielding a 19.0% increase in sensitivity or a 62.6% reduction in false positive rates at the clinical baseline. This extensive evaluation confirms that TRACE delivers both strong performance on benchmark tasks and tangible clinical impact in the most acute, high-risk cardiac scenarios.

AI.tldr: TRACE多模态ECG模型在急性冠脉闭塞检测中较临床基线显著提升敏感性19.0%或降低假阳性率62.6%，并在心律失常分类等公开基准上表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有CLIP式ECG训练易受噪声临床文本干扰，且未能充分利用单模态（ECG）与跨模态（ECG与心内科报告）学习的互补优势；同时，急性冠脉闭塞的ST段抬高标准漏诊25-34%，亟需更精准的ECG表征方法。
AI.method: 提出TRACE混合架构，通过不确定性加权多任务学习联合学习单模态与跨模态表征，并利用LLM流程从心内科报告中提取高保真发现。在公开基准（心律失常分类、结构异常）及大型私有急性冠脉闭塞数据集（专家标注金标准）上评估，比较现有单模态与多模态ECG模型及真实临床实践。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，TRACE相对现有单模态与多模态ECG模型表现稳健；在急性冠脉闭塞验证中，TRACE显著优于真实临床实践，在临床基线水平上敏感性提高19.0%或假阳性率降低62.6%。摘要未报告具体置信区间与P值。
AI.conclusion: TRACE在基准任务和急性高危心脏场景中均展现强性能与切实临床影响，有望改善急性冠脉闭塞的ECG筛查。局限性包括私有数据集未公开、缺乏统计细节，需外部验证。

summary_zh: TRACE（Text-Reinforced Analysis of Cardio ECGs）是一种多模态心电图（ECG）表征模型，可学习具有临床依据的信号嵌入，用于下游心脏分类。它旨在解决现有 CLIP 式训练的局限性，这类训练往往难以处理嘈杂的临床文本，且未能利用单模态（来自 ECG）与跨模态（ECG 与匹配的心内科医生报告之间）学习的互补优势。为弥补这一空白，我们提出一种混合架构，通过不确定性加权多任务学习联合学习单模态与跨模态表征，同时利用基于 LLM 的流程从心内科医生报告中提取高保真发现。我们在涵盖临床紧急程度谱系的场景中评估 TRACE，相对于现有单模态和多模态 ECG 模型，在心律失常分类和结构异常的公共基准上确立了稳健的性能。为展示真实世界实用性，我们进一步在急性冠状动脉闭塞（ACO）上验证该模型，现有 ST 抬高标准会漏诊 25-34% 的真性闭塞。利用一个带有专家标注金标准的大型私有 ACO 数据集，TRACE 显著优于真实世界临床实践，在临床基线水平上灵敏度提高 19.0%，或假阳性率降低 62.6%。这一广泛评估证实，TRACE 在基准任务上均提供强劲性能，并在最急性、高风险的心脏场景中产生切实的临床影响。
